body:
The room was dark; it was pitch black other than one lit candle against the wall in the middle of the room.  The fan was blowing really hard and it made the shadows flicker really fast. The wall took on the shape of a huge metallic eagle flapping its wings with liquid light pouring from its body. Out of nowhere the candle blew out and it was pitch black. The room became extremely clear, but I was somewhere else, a completely different room. It was really clear in the corner of the room with a lot of gray.
Suddenly a creature comes into my visual field from the right side. It has a huge neck that takes up half my vision; it is maybe 10 feet tall. All I could see was the face; it had very small eyes that were wide and squinted hard. The nose was larger but relatively small, but the mouth was half the size of the face and just stayed open, it was very eerie and looking back was a little creepy, but at the time I embraced it and wasnt scared at all. It was as if in a joking way it said to me, I told you not to come back again, this place feels like a dimension outside ours. The whole trip up until the point was spent with a friend who went it on the fairy dust with me. Our trip was almost the same, the only difference was his creature he saw didnt have a face, and mine had a very detailed face that raped my soul. After I retired for the night and went back to my place I decided to take one last trip to the DMT universe.
I packed up relatively a quarter gram sandwiched between some weed in my bong. I took at least 5 hits and held it until I couldnt any more, I do not remember ever exhaling; all I felt was my eyes being turned off and my brain seeing every possible complex geometric pattern possible. The patterns faded and I was in a village in a jungle somewhere, and there were structures everywhere that resembled huts. But these structures were made of millions of rods that were just different colors of light, it was the most intense thing I have ever been through, but I loved it. I was swimming through these huts at a very fast speed and see all of the perfectly. When I started coming down it had been about 10 minutes, but it felt like hours. Everything had a chrome-illusion glow to it, all the edges of everything in the room glowed a color that looked like every color at one time, it is like liquid rainbow, but it comes out looking metallic orange. This night forever changed my life and made me a better person, I love DMT!
